Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
6:05 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a fast SSD and a good screen, and don't spend extra on a gaming graphics card unless you need one.

RAM: 16 GB minimum. Pick one with a spare slot so you can upgrade later.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more.
Processor: a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 (H or U series). Apple's M-series is also strong if you can find one in budget.
Screen and keyboard: a 14 to 16 inch full HD or better screen with a comfortable keyboard, since you'll look at it all day.
Battery: 8 hours or more of real use, if you work away from a desk.
